stories.title: Acidentes, condenação de hospital e luta contra leucemia estão entre as mais lidas da semana

en.title: Accidents, hospital conviction and fight against leukemia are among the most read of the week
en.summary: G1 Grande Minas reported on the week's five most-accessed stories, featuring the release of accident victims' bodies in Pedra Azul, a couple's death on BR-135, and a young person's plea for help obtaining medication for rare leukemia treatment.

stories.title: Prefeitura apura suspeita de funcionamento de escola de tênis em terreno cedido para atividades da PUC-SP

en.title: City Hall investigates suspected operation of tennis school on land granted to PUC-SP
en.summary: São Paulo's municipal government opened an administrative process to investigate alleged commercial operation of a tennis school on land granted to PUC-SP for specific purposes.

stories.title: Cansaço, coceira e inchaço podem indicar problema no fígado

en.title: Fatigue, itching and swelling may indicate liver problems
en.summary: Liver diseases often progress silently without clear symptoms, but persistent signs such as fatigue, itching and swelling may indicate liver issues warranting medical investigation.

stories.title: Apostas do Paraná acertam a quina da Mega-Sena e faturam mais de R$ 73 mil; veja cidades premiadas

en.title: Paraná bets hit Mega-Sena five numbers and win over R$ 73 thousand; see winning cities
en.summary: Three bets from Paraná matched five of the six numbers in Mega-Sena draw 3063, splitting over R$ 73 thousand in prizes. The jackpot accumulated to R$ 52 million for the next drawing.

stories.title: Irã volta a defender acordo após Trump rejeitar proposta de paz

en.title: Iran reaffirms support for accord after Trump rejects peace proposal
en.summary: Iran reiterated its support for a diplomatic solution to its conflict with the United States and Israel following Trump's rejection of an Iranian proposal to reopen the Strait of Hormuz and end hostilities. Iran's Foreign Minister stated that reopening the strait depends on meeting Iran's conditions.

stories.title: Mega-Sena 3063: sortudo de cidade mais populosa de SC fica a um número de faturar R$ 45 milhões

en.title: Mega-Sena 3063: Lucky winner from most populous city in SC misses 45 million reais by one number
en.summary: A lottery ticket from Joinville, Santa Catarina's largest city, matched five of six numbers in the Mega-Sena draw worth 45 million reais. No ticket matched all six numbers, so the jackpot accumulated for the next draw.

stories.title: Resultado da Mega-Sena 3063: 15 apostas do PI acertam a quadra; bolão fatura R$ 3.968,37

en.title: Mega-Sena 3063 result: 15 bets from PI win four numbers; pool wins 3,968.37 reais
en.summary: Fifteen lottery tickets from Piauí matched four numbers in the Mega-Sena 3063 draw. A pool bet from Luís Correia with seven numbers won four numbers three times, earning 3,968.37 reais in total.

stories.title: Mega-Sena acumula para R$ 52 milhões; veja os números sorteados

en.title: Mega-Sena accumulates to 52 million reais; see the drawn numbers
en.summary: The Mega-Sena jackpot accumulated to 52 million reais after the Concurso 3063 draw, as no ticket matched all six numbers. Twenty-nine bets matched five numbers and 2,642 bets matched four numbers.

stories.title: Mega-Sena 3063 acumula e premiação pode chegar a R$ 52 milhões na terça (29)

en.title: Mega-Sena 3063 accumulates and prize may reach R$ 52 million on Tuesday (29)
en.summary: No winner was selected in Sunday's Mega-Sena draw 3063 with a prize of R$ 42.6 million. The accumulated jackpot may reach R$ 52 million in the next drawing on Tuesday.

stories.title: Antes de se reunir com vítimas de abusos na França, papa insta a Igreja a enfrentar as próprias falhas

en.title: Before meeting with abuse victims in France, pope urges Church to confront its own failures
en.summary: Pope Leo 14 called on the Catholic Church to acknowledge its failings and heal deep wounds inflicted within it, ahead of a Sunday meeting with victims of priest sexual abuse in France.

stories.title: Papa exorta Igreja a enfrentar suas falhas antes de se reunir com vítimas de abuso na França

en.title: Pope urges Church to confront its failures before meeting with abuse victims in France
en.summary: The Pope addresses the Church's need to face its failures in relation to abuse cases before meeting with victims in France.

stories.title: Irã insiste em solução diplomática após Trump rejeitar plano de paz

en.title: Iran insists on diplomatic solution after Trump rejects peace plan
en.summary: Iran continues to pursue a diplomatic approach following Trump's rejection of a proposed peace plan.

stories.title: IPCA-15 volta a acelerar e afasta inflação da meta, apontam economistas

en.title: IPCA-15 accelerates again and moves inflation away from target, economists say
en.summary: Brazil's September IPCA-15 inflation index rose 0.7%, exceeding market expectations and reducing prospects of meeting the 3% annual inflation target set by the Monetary Council. The index accumulated a 4.47% increase over the past 12 months.

stories.title: Análise/Humberto Saccomandi: Está mais difícil agradar ao eleitor ocidental

en.title: Analysis/Humberto Saccomandi: It is becoming more difficult to please Western voters
en.summary: Voters across Western nations are increasingly punishing governments of both left and right ideologies, with recent electoral shifts in Germany, Sweden, Colombia, UK, and Peru. Brazil, the US, and France may face similar voter dissatisfaction in upcoming elections.

stories.title: NFL realiza hoje seu primeiro jogo no Maracanã com expectativa de espetáculo e casa cheia

en.title: NFL holds its first game at Maracanã today with expectations of spectacle and full house
en.summary: The NFL is staging its first game at Rio's Maracanã Stadium today, featuring exclusive broadcasts on SporTV and Ge TV. This marks the third consecutive year the American football league has held a game in Brazil.

stories.title: Agenda do STF: Ministros pautam tributação de benefícios fiscais e reajuste de plano de saúde de idosos

en.title: STF agenda: Ministers schedule taxation of fiscal benefits and health plan adjustments for the elderly
en.summary: Brazil's Supreme Federal Court may rule on whether PIS and Cofins taxes apply to fiscal benefits granted by states through presumed ICMS credits. The Union estimates the financial impact of this ruling at 16.5 billion reais.
